**Finding: missing (medium severity) — TRANSITION**

The agreement has no post-termination transition or data-return mechanic:

- **§11** covers term (§11.1), breach/insolvency termination (§11.2) and survival (§11.3). §11.3 helpfully preserves our right to keep serving then-existing Customers and Commerce One's ongoing support obligation, but says nothing about transition assistance, migration, or return of data.
- Searches for "transition" return nothing, and "data" hits only definitional/warranty uses — no export, return or deletion timing anywhere.
- **§12** is source-code escrow only, triggered by narrow Release Conditions (dissolution or repeated support breach), so it is not an exit remedy on ordinary expiry or termination.
- §11.3's generic "return or destroy any Confidential Information" sentence could actually cut against us by letting Commerce One destroy data held in the MarketSite.net Service.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new **§11.4** inserted after p0098 — (a) up to six (6) months of transition assistance, including continued Software/MarketSite.net access needed to support or migrate our Customers, at Commerce One's then-current rates; (b) return of all Corio/Customer/Software User data within thirty (30) days in a commonly used machine-readable format; (c) deletion thereafter with written certification — expressly overriding §11.3's return-or-destroy sentence. Fallback of 90 days' assistance flagged in the comment, with data return and deletion certification held firm.
